response.overview: At long last, the Warner brothers...and the Warner sister have escaped from the studios famous water tower to continue the legacy of lunacy they began over 50 years ago! sohers the inside scoop on the silliest siblings in show business- how they got started and why they're impossible to stop! You'll meet Yakko, Wakko and Dot- along with studio boss Mr. Plotz and psychiatrist Dr. Otto Scratchansniff. Then, follow these whirling dervishes of Warner mischief onto a studio soundstage where they teach a famous director a lesson in kamikaze comedy! Before the days over, Yakko Wakko and Dot rendezvous with your favorite stars of stage, screen and Jurassic Park for an adventure packed escapade inside a video store. Don't miss one minute of this wacky day in the life of the wacky Warners.
response.title: Animaniacs
